description: This file contains data access layer functions for managing Dealer, StockEntry, PayrollCredit, and Payment entities in a dealer management system. It includes functions for creating records, retrieving dealer data, computing financial summaries, and generating activity feeds, all implemented using SQLAlchemy ORM and core expressions.

methods.name: Dealer create_dealer(db: Session, *, name: str, phone: str | None, address: str | None)
methods.description: Creates a new dealer record with specified name, phone, and address.

methods.name: list[Dealer] list_dealers(db: Session)
methods.description: Returns a list of all dealer records ordered by name.

methods.name: Dealer|None get_dealer(db: Session, dealer_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a dealer by its ID if it exists.

methods.name: StockEntry create_stock_entry( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, item_name: str, quantity: int, unit_cost: Decimal, stock_date: dt.date | None, )
methods.description: Creates a stock entry for a dealer with item details and total cost calculation.

methods.name: PayrollCredit create_payroll_credit( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, description: str | None, amount: Decimal, credit_date: dt.date | None, )
methods.description: Creates a payroll or credit record for a dealer with optional description.

methods.name: Payment create_payment( db: Session, *, dealer_id: int, amount: Decimal, paid_at: dt.datetime | None, note: str | None, )
methods.description: Creates a payment record for a dealer with optional note.

methods.name: dict[str,Decimal]|None compute_dealer_ledger_summary(db: Session, dealer_id: int)
methods.description: Calculates ledger summaries including totals for stock, credits, payments, and balance for a dealer.

methods.name: dict[str,Decimal] compute_finance_totals(db: Session)
methods.description: Aggregates total stock value, credits, payments, and outstanding balance across all dealers.

methods.name: list[dict] list_finance_per_dealer_summaries(db: Session, *, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Provides paginated summaries per dealer for dashboard display, including unpaid counts.

methods.name: list[dict] list_finance_activity(db: Session, *, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Returns a combined activity feed of recent stock entries, credits, and payments ordered chronologically.
